dedupe_keys.name: here technologies map data dynamic traffic content and location platform

description: HERE Technologies sells digital map data, real-time dynamic content and location services, collected in part by hundreds of its own mapping vehicles, together with a cloud platform for processing location data. Coverage: real-time spatial data and 2D and 3D map content for 200 countries with more than 1,000 detailed attributes, which HERE describes as a digital duplicate of reality; product lines include map data for building custom maps and layers, dynamic map content APIs for real-time journey information such as traffic, maps for assisted and automated driving (ADAS and HAD), routing for several transport modes, geocoding and search, and positioning. Format and access: the HERE platform with data catalogues, a marketplace of curated datasets, processing pipelines and analytics, plus APIs and SDKs; data are delivered in standard formats; a free start and usage-based pricing with volume discounts under the HERE Base Plan, and enterprise contracts on request. Licence: commercial terms, not read. Caveats: the attribute lists, update frequency and historical archives of individual layers such as traffic were not read; the pricing page shows no figures without a contact step. Simulation uses: road network topology, speeds and real-time and historical traffic for transport network flow, routing, emergency response and digital twin models. Related records: TomTom map and traffic data (data-tomtom-maps-traffic-and-move-portal), a direct competitor.
